Though I Am an Inept Villainess | Official Trailer | Netflix Anime
On the night of a bright comet, a forbidden magic swaps the fates of Reirin and Keigetsu. Entangled in each other's lives, they must work together to survive the deadly threats lurking beneath the palace's genial surface.

Though I Am an Inept Villainess is now playing with English dubs available in select regions of Asia.
